evidence_quotes: Chainbase’s previous partner was chosen to host its Web3 data platform as its US data centres were cost effective at the time, allowing a flexible, quick start for Chainbase as it established itself.
However, due to rapid growth Chainbase saw the need to improve efficiency and computing resources to help it progress faster.
Its existing cloud resources with the previous partner were taking up a significant portion of operating expenses, stealing vital resources from growth opportunities.
Chainbase was therefore looking for a highly stable, secure and cost effective cloud partner that could host its Web3 data platform during this period of high-speed expansion and beyond.
Crucially, with over 200TB of data to transfer, migration required a partner to act quickly, without disruption.
